in_sanskrit.name: योगिथा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who embodies the divine qualities of a Yogini or a Goddess who practices yoga and disciplines herself to attain enlightenment and spiritual growth.

in_hindi.name: योगिथा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Yogi ke saathi, yogini - companion or helper of a Yogi or Yogini.

in_tamil.name: யோகிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Yogathin adikal, adhikariyum adikal - helpers or caretakers of the divine discipline or practice of Yoga.

in_telugu.name: యోగిథా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Yogini, yogapudu - a Yogini or a practitioner of yoga.

in_marathi.name: Yogitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yogitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yogitha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yogita', meaning 'Divine Woman'. This name is often used to refer to goddesses associated with yoga, meditation, and spiritual growth.
